title: Thornberry, Knocksink, Enniskerry, Co. Wicklow, A98E9C2
seoTitle: Thornberry, Knocksink, Enniskerry, Co. Wicklow, A98E9C2
description:
Garrett O Bric Property Advisors are delighted to showcase this substantial family residence, nestled in the heart of the picturesque village of Enniskerry. This charming village is certainly one of North Wicklows most prestigious and sought after residential addresses. This sale offers a rare opportunity to acquire an exceptional home with an abundance of potential enjoying a tranquil leafy setting. The quaint village of Enniskerry is just moments walk and boasts a unique village charm, centred around a wonderful clock tower and home to a range of artisan shops, cafes and restaurants. Ideal for families the area is home to a selection of schools and creches, while public transport links provide speedy access to Bray providing a further range of schools. For those commuting a little further, DART and rail services are available in Bray and the LUAS Green Line is just a ten minute drive away. Sporting and recreation opportunities abound and include the prestigious Powerscourt Golf Club which is just minutes away. For a wonderful treat the superb Powerscourt Resort Hotel and Spa is also close at hand and perfect for a gentle stroll, Enniskerry is also home to the renowned Powerscourt Gardens and Waterfall. The sea is just minutes drive away providing opportunities for a variety of water sports and being set in the garden of Ireland this is the perfect location for hill walking enthusiasts. 
This exceptional five bedroom home was built in an era when homes were designed with space, proportion and comfort in mind teamed with wonderful gardens and Thornberry certainly has it all. While in need of some updating and refurbishment, this sale presents a unique opportunity for the new owners to personalise the space and create their dream home in the right location. With a little imagination, this home could be transformed into a stunning home that reflects your individual style. The amazing potential of this home is immediately evident as soon as you cross the threshold, with spacious light filled interiors. The layout is well balanced creating the perfect home for modern living with generous interconnecting living spaces, a family kitchen diner, and five spacious bedrooms. One of the standout features of this home is the wonderful gardens, the rear is fully enclosed and creates an oasis of tranquility, the perfect space to sit back and relax, while the front garden offers excellent off street parking. 
Viewing of this wonderful home is highly recommended to truly appreciate the full potential of this well located home. 


Features Include 

Superb Location Just A Stones Throw From the Picturesque Village of Enniskerry
Premier Address 
Boasting Impressive Mountain Views 
Generous Gardens 
Obvious Potential to Extend the Footprint Should the Need Arise
Extensive Accommodation Comprising 160.17 square metres of Light Filled Accommodation
Within Walking Distance of Local Schools
Excellent Public Transport Links Close at Hand 


Accommodation 

Entrance Hallway 
Sets the tone perfect and boasts a bright welcoming approach. A staircase here rises to the upper level. 

Reception Room 1
3.6 x 6.3m 
This wonderful spacious room lies to the rear of the property and enjoys open aspect overlooking the rear garden, a picture window bathes the room in natural light. Ideal for entertaining or everyday family living alike the room enjoys a cosy ambience with a feature stone fireplace creating a warm and friendly central focus point. Double doors lead to the dining room. 

Dining Room 
4.3 x 3.8m 
This wonderful separate dining room allows plenty of space for a large dining table ideal for entertaining, again with a super aspect overlooking the rear garden. 

Family Kitchen Diner
2.7 x 5.6m 
This family kitchen boasts plenty of room for both cooking and dining, this room is flooded in natural light with a picture window overlooking the front garden. The kitchen area features a range of wall and floor units with stainless steel sink and drainer finished with a tiled splash back. A door here leads to the side garden. 

Play Room or Bedroom No 5
2.7 x 5.2m 
Again this room overlooks the front garden and is perfect for a variety of uses, currently used as bedroom 5 the room features a bank of fitted wardrobes. 

Shower room 
This downstairs shower room features a wc, wash hand basin and shower cubicle. 

Upstairs
A carpeted staircase rises to a bright landing with plenty of natural light from a side window, the hotpress here provides an abundance of linen storage. 

Bedroom No. 1
4.3 x 3.8m 
Double bedroom overlooking the rear garden and boasting impressive views over the countryside and mountains beyond. 

Bedroom No. 2
4.3 x 3.7m 
Double bedroom again overlooking the rear garden and boasting those wonderful views. 

Bedroom No. 3
3.5 x 3.5m 
Set to the front of the property, this double bedroom boasts built in wardrobes providing ample storage. 

Bedroom No 4
3.5 x 3.4m 
Again set to the front of the property, this double bedroom is home to built in wardrobes. 

Family Bathroom 
Family bathroom with original coloured three piece suite and part tiled walls. 

Outside

Thornberry boasts wonderful gardens, set well back from the road in front, the front gardens offer generous parking for a number of cars while a lawned area to one side is home to specimen trees and shrubs. Meticulously well tended mature hedging adds screening and privacy. To the rear there is a truly wonderful tranquil garden, the perfect space to sit back and relax, adjoining the house lies a paved patio area creating an outdoor dining space for al fresco dining. This charming garden features extensive lawns and flowerbeds with a variety of plants, roses, shrubs and trees. At the bottom of the garden lies a greenhouse perfect for nurturing seedlings for later planting.
